objective: minimize mean rerank candidates among candidate choices [20,40,80,160]
caveats: Calibrated on 5 synthetic seeds across two sizes; no generalization guarantee
Ranking uses exact float32 oracle ONLY for calibration evaluation; query-level selection uses quantized score margins alone
Aggregate hits treat top5 elements as micro-accuracy not real-world independent queries
Candidate selection still scans int8 top160 and chooses the number of float32 candidates to rerank
